name: VoiceDelta
description: VoiceDelta is an AI voice generation platform for content creators who need realistic AI voiceovers and voice cloning.
features: Thousands of studio-quality AI voices across many languages
Instant voice cloning from a short clean audio recording
Text-to-speech generation with multiple voice engines
Controls for speed, pitch variation, emotion and pacing
sales_points: Affordable monthly plan with unlimited generations
Multiple premium voice engines in a single portal
Commercial rights included for monetized content
requirements: A short clean audio recording for voice cloning
limitations: Free plan has a per-generation character limit
how_to_use:
1. Log into the dashboard.
2. Pick a voice or clone your own.
3. Paste your script and generate.
4. Download the audio file.

links.title: VoiceDelta Web Portal
links.note: Web portal for generation and voice cloning

sections.title: Constant Dynamic Knowledge Message
sections.content: VoiceDelta provides a large library of AI voices with cloning support. The monthly plan includes unlimited generations.

pricing.negotiation_notes: Fixture floor only. Can offer min_negotiable_pkr for same-day payment.

objection_responses.too_expensive: Break the monthly price down into a per-day cost against what it replaces.
objection_responses.comparing_competitor: Highlight multiple engines in one place with local payment.

faq.question: How accurate is the voice cloning?
faq.answer: With a clean one-minute recording the clone closely matches the original.

name: ClipShield - YouTube Copyright Claim Remover
description: ClipShield is a desktop application for content creators to download, edit and repurpose YouTube videos while reducing the risk of copyright claims. It downloads HD streams, finds engaging clips, reframes to 9:16 and applies layered processing.
features: Direct HD Video Downloader: paste a YouTube URL and download HD streams
AI Viral Hook Finder: scans long-form video to identify engaging clips
Smart 9:16 Reframing: converts landscape videos to vertical shorts
Layered Content ID processing: audio pitch, micro-speed, colour grade and crop filters
Fast local processing: rendering runs on your own computer
sales_points: Operates locally on your PC so your video assets stay private
Removes hours of manual editing work
Flexible Pricing: Monthly License at Rs. 1,500 and Lifetime License at Rs. 3,500 (negotiable down to Rs. 2,800 for immediate payment)
Lifetime updates included with the Lifetime License
Includes one free trial video to test before paying
use_cases: Repurposing videos for Shorts, TikTok and Reels
Finding highlights in podcasts and interviews
requirements: Hardware ID (HWID) copied from application settings for license activation
limitations: Requires a license key for unlimited processing
Free version includes one trial video
how_to_use:
1. Download the application and read the setup guide.
2. Open ClipShield, go to Settings and copy your Hardware ID (HWID).
3. Send your HWID to activate your license.
4. Paste your license key and start processing.
